description:
"Teacher, I'm sorry. It seems it will be difficult to be a well-behaved student today." 

Yuria Rigby is a fallen noble and the live-in tutor for the Ducal House of Cunningham. Although the job posting explicitly stated they would not hire Omegas, she boldly entered the household pretending to be a Beta, as a physical anomaly had kept her heat cycles at bay for a long time. Her student, Luke Cunningham, is a brilliant and dignified Alpha who has possessed natural talent and elegance since his youth. While Yuria lived in constant anxiety, the situation reversed when Luke reached adulthood. His mature Alpha pheromones triggered Yuria’s long-dormant heat cycle, causing her body to prepare itself for an Alpha slowly. On the night her self-control finally shattered, the Alpha, Luke Cunningham, visited her room and found his teacher suffering through heat. 

"You lied to me. Two lies, to be exact."

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14061451)
